author: agent Q
status: PREREGISTERED (fixed before the first evaluation run; any change = topic_v2 with a note)

tracks.PROCESS: 72 processes PC-xx of catalogues/physics (name + 2 paraphrases; targets = evidence pages of process_evidence_links.csv)
tracks.MODEL_FAMILY: 45 families MM-<FAMILY> of MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_REGISTRY.csv (a Russian family title + 2 paraphrases written for the set; targets = VKM-SRC locator pages); PDE (no corpus locator) and DER (derived by this project) excluded

set.query_rule: the NAME variant of a process is the catalogue name verbatim; paraphrases and family titles are written by agent Q without corpus text
set.target_rule: one target per unique canonical page of a topic; acceptable alternates: quote-anchored page (catalogue locator off by 1-3 pages), DOCX 023 render drift, duplicate-group pages; grade 2 = KEY link, 1 = SUPPORT link or registry locator; primary metrics are binary
set.nature_of_truth: the targets are a human-curated sample of relevant pages, not an exhaustive judgement: recall-oriented metrics only, no precision

hybrid_late.note: late = null means the server default (VKM_HYBRID_LATE_DEFAULT); the answer's record.late is recorded

hybrid_nolate.role: hybrid BM25 + dense RRF without the late stage

calls: GET /v1/nav/concept?term=<TRM id>&limit=20 for each of the top 5 neighbours
nav.ranking: weighted RRF (k = 60) of node lists: search_sections order (w 1), matched term top_units (w 1), each neighbour's top_units (w 0.5); a unit with a section_id is that section (entry pages = the unit's page_ids), a unit without one is a pseudo-node of its page_ids; ties by first appearance
nav.pages: two passes over the ranked nodes: (1) entry pages (unit page_ids; the first page of a section from search_sections), (2) the remaining pages of each node's range in reading order; duplicates removed; first 50 pages

dossier.role: reconstruct_topic dossier (agent D) - adapter only; run by the coordinator after deploy
dossier.ranking: page ids in document order of the JSON answer (page part of block/object ids included), then the pages of the section ids it names; sections = its section ids, else the deepest sections of its first 10 pages

metrics.matching: a target is found at rank r if its primary page, an alternate, or a duplicate alias of the r-th retrieved page (the API collapses duplicate pages) coincide
metrics.page_recall@k: found targets within the first k pages / all targets of the topic; k in 10, 20, 50
metrics.capped_recall@k: found targets within k / min(k, n_targets) (secondary)
metrics.success@10: 1 if any target within the first 10 pages (secondary)
metrics.mrr@50: 1 / rank of the first retrieved page matching any target; 0 if none within 50
metrics.source_recall@10: target sources present among the sources of the first 10 retrieved pages (aliases included) / target sources
metrics.section_hit@10: 1 if a target page lies inside the pages of the top-10 section nodes; nodes of page systems = the deepest NAV sections (from /v1/nav/outline) of their first 10 pages, a page outside every section being its own node; nodes of nav = its first 10 ranked nodes
metrics.section_recall@10: targets inside the top-10 nodes / targets (secondary)
metrics.section_pages@10: number of pages inside the top-10 nodes: the reading budget behind section_hit (reported next to it)

aggregation.per_query: every query (3 per topic) is scored separately
aggregation.means: mean over queries of a system; breakdowns by track, by process group (14 groups of the PROCESS track), by variant (NAME / PARA1 / PARA2)
aggregation.tests_unit: topic (mean of its 3 variants): the paraphrases of a topic are not independent

comparisons.test: paired sign-flip randomization over topic means, two-sided, n = 10000, seed 20260928; 95 % percentile bootstrap CI of the mean difference (same seed); Holm correction over the 6 tests
comparisons.secondary: all other metrics and pairs are descriptive

acceptance_levels.note: orientation levels chosen before the run without prior data (MODEL_CHOICE of agent Q): the first screen should show evidence for most topics, and a 50-page reading budget should reach a substantial share of the known evidence
acceptance_levels.over: mean over all 351 queries of a system

failure_analysis.reference_system: hybrid_late (deployed default); nav is analysed separately
failure_analysis.missed_target: a target not found within the first 50 pages by any of the 3 queries of its topic
causes_in_precedence: NO_TEXT: page char_count < 100, page_status PARTIAL/OCR_REQUIRED or EMPTY_PAGE/IMAGE_NO_TEXT/VECTOR_NO_TEXT flags
VISUAL_EVIDENCE: evidence read from a figure/table image (VISUAL_READ, GRAPH_DIGITIZED_APPROX) or a page with a figure/table and < 800 characters of text
LANGUAGE: share of Cyrillic letters in the page text < 0.5 (queries are Russian)
OCR_QUALITY: text quality flags (GARBAGE_GLYPHS, BROKEN_TEXT_LAYER, LOW_FUNCTION_WORD_RATE, MOJIBAKE_NOT_REPAIRABLE, TRUNCATED, FONT_WITHOUT_TOUNICODE, UNMAPPED_SYMBOL_GLYPHS, PUA_GLYPHS)
TERMINOLOGY: < 25 % of the topic's query stems (5-letter prefixes of words of >= 5 letters, all 3 variants) occur on the page
SECTION_MISSING (nav only): the page lies outside every NAV section
DILUTION: another page of the same source is within the first 50 (the page loses to its neighbours)
failure_analysis.worst_queries: 10 queries of the reference system with the lowest page_recall@50, ties by mrr@50 then query_id (ids only)

run_rules.where: inside the VKM API container on CORE (docker exec into vkm-core-api-1), read-only API calls, token read from the mounted file and never printed
run_rules.retries: one retry after 2 s on a transport error or HTTP 5xx; failures are recorded, not re-drawn
run_rules.outputs: raw answers as IDs only (page, section, term ids, ranks, timings) in a host-local work directory; PUBLIC gets metrics and IDs, never corpus text
